messages:
maria (support): FYI customer cust_7632 reporting intermittent 504s + 5xxs hitting hosted API during a traffic burst since 09:11 PDT. ~20-30% of requests timeout. Sample curl they sent:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Request-ID: rwd:abcd-1234

maria (support): customer says no deploys in window, traffic spike from marketing campaign. They want root cause and ETA. Escalating to infra.

dan (eng-sre): taking this. can you paste the full request-id+time range? grabbing autoscaler and queue metrics now. Any sign of auth failures or 429s?

maria (support): timeframe 2026-03-15T09:11:00Z - 2026-03-15T09:25:00Z. I saw a handful of 429s earlier but majority are gateway 504s.

olivia (platform): short check of scaler config for the tenant (prod namespace):
```
$ kubectl get scaledobject scaled-cust-7632 -n prod -o yaml
# excerpt: pollInterval: 60s
# cooldownPeriod: 300s
# minReplicaCount: 0
# triggers: kafka lag threshold
```
That pollInterval + cooldown is really slow for sudden bursts — KEDA will wait up to 60s to notice and then cooldown keeps it down. minReplicaCount=0 means cold starts.

kevin (eng-runtime): runtime logs for a few ids show long model init times on cold pods. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:05Z] ModelLoader:init start model=redwood-large pod=redwood-runtime-12
[2026-03-15T09:12:32Z] ModelLoader:init complete model=redwood-large duration=27.3s
[2026-03-15T09:12:33Z] request= rwd:abcd-1234 -> downstream timeout 502/504
```
So scale-up + model load = ~25-30s extra. Combined with KEDA sampling delay, we hit gateway timeouts.

maria (support): customer also noted some billing-related 429 spikes earlier but they look separate; they retried which may have amplified the burst.

dan (eng-sre): immediate mitigation: bump minReplicaCount to 1 or 2 for scaledobject for cust_7632 and lower pollInterval to 10-15s, cooldown to 60s. Also add a readiness/prewarm hook so new pods load model before traffic. I'll propose the PR changes.

lucas (support-eng): I repro'd locally: sent 200 concurrent small requests -> queue length grows, new pods get created but stay pending until scaler kicks in (~40-50s), requests started 504ing around 10-20s after spike. Increasing minReplicas to 2 removed the 504s in my run.

infra-bot: [alert] autoscaler-lag-prod cust_7632 exceeded threshold: 90th percentile scale-up delay = 46s, triggered at 2026-03-15T09:12Z.

oncall-rotations: paging dan (eng-sre) as primary. If unresolved in 30m, escalate to oncall2.

kevin (eng-runtime): applied temporary mitigation (manual): patched scaledobject minReplicaCount=2, pollInterval=15s, cooldown=60s for cust_7632. Also started a prewarm job to trigger model load on the two replicas. Monitoring looks better: 5xx rate down to normal within 2m.

dan (eng-sre): logged incident in tracking system, will open follow-up to:
- change tenant autoscaler defaults for bursty tenants (minReplicaCount >= 1),
- add tenant-specific prewarm capability + SDK for proactive prewarm,
- audit KEDA pollInterval/cooldown defaults (prod-safe defaults),
- add synthetic spike tests in staging for onboarding steps.

maria (support): notified the customer about mitigation and ETA for a permanent change. Customer responded :thumbsup:.

kevin (eng-runtime): long-term fix: implement fast-path prewarm API + maintain a small warm pool per tenant for paid/enterprise customers. I'll draft an RFC.

maria (support): good. will schedule follow-up with PMs & cust success to discuss opt-in warm pools for critical tenants. closing this thread when follow-ups are tracked.
